answers.text: The ability link disabled by the caster behavior changes from XalatathVoidEruption to XalatathVoidEruptionV2.
The multiplicative damage modifier at index XalatathFracturedReality of the Void Volley damage effect changes from 0.25 to 0.15.
The XalatathVoidEruptionV2 ability is now flagged as affected by cooldown reduction and Overdrive, Heroic and shown in hero select, and the XalatathVoidEruption ability loses those flags.
The talent no longer multiplies the radius of the XalatathUnstableCoreFireSearchArea area by 1.25.

The applied behavior changes from XalatathCloakOfShadowsSpellArmorAndMoveSpeed to XalatathCloakOfShadowsMoveSpeed, and a flat Hero ability armor modification of $XalatathCloakOfShadowsSpellArmorBonus is added.
The Duration modification of the XalatathToxicMarkArmorDebuff behavior is set to 2.000000, replacing a Chance modification of 1.000000 on the XalatathShadowMarkApplyFrozenMarkBehavior effect.

The cooldown reduction per Hero hit used by the Void Eruption execute cost changes from XalatathOrbitalEruptionCooldownReductionPerHeroHit to XalatathVoidEruptionV2HarbingersConsumptionCooldownReductionPerHeroHit.

Basic Attack damage dealt gains a flat DamageDealtFraction modification of 0.750000 through the Void Step charge weapon behavior, and the XalatathPummelingStepCasterBehavior no longer has an additive attack speed factor of $XalatathPummelingStepAttackSpeedModifer.
The talent no longer applies a flat Duration modification of 1.000000 to the XalatathShadowMarkDebuff behavior.
The XalatathUnstableCoreDamage constant is set to 75, while the XalatathUnstableCoreFireDOTDamage constant of 45 and the XalatathUnstableCoreFireDuration constant of 5 are removed.
The heroic ability is changed from XalatathVoidEruption to XalatathVoidEruptionV2.
